findings.location: source.html — paragraph 2 ("The devastations of the Thirty Years’ War...")
findings.source_quote: Europe had just gone through the devastations of the Thirty Years’ War (1618-1648).
findings.suggested_fix: Correct Portuguese grammar/number agreement and natural plural: change “A Europa havia acabado de passar pelas devastação da Guerra dos Trinta Anos (1618–1648).” to “A Europa havia acabado de passar pelas devastações da Guerra dos Trinta Anos (1618–1648).”
findings.translation_quote: A Europa havia acabado de passar pelas devastação da Guerra dos Trinta Anos (1618–1648).

findings.source_quote: Huge walnut, hickory, chestnuts, maples, white pines, and oaks, some six feet in diameter and over 100 feet tall, covered much of their new lands
findings.suggested_fix: Use a more idiomatic/standard Portuguese name for 'hickory' (avoid literal or uncommon compound). Replace “nogueiras-pecan” with a conventional form such as “nogueiras (hickory)” or “hickory (nogueira-americana)” depending on house style. Example: “Grandes nogueiras, hickory, castanheiras, bordo, pinheiros-brancos e carvalhos...” or “Grandes nogueiras (hickory), castanheiras, bordo...”
findings.translation_quote: Grandes nogueiras, nogueiras-pecan, castanheiras, bordo, pinheiros-brancos e carvalhos, alguns com cerca de seis pés de diâmetro e mais de 100 pés de altura, cobriam grande parte de suas novas terras (exceto por alguns prados abertos, deixados pelos nativos americanos, e áreas alagadiças).

findings.source_quote: Many of the Hoffs (house/barn fort enclosures) were burned out and the fields were left uncultivated for years.
findings.suggested_fix: Use a clearer Portuguese rendering for the parenthetical explanation. Replace “Hoffs (enclausuras de casa/curral)” with a more natural phrase such as “Hoffs (recintos fortificados de casa/curral)” or “Hoffs (recintos fortificados de casa e celeiro)”.
findings.translation_quote: Muitos dos Hoffs (enclausuras de casa/curral) foram incendiados e os campos ficaram incultos por anos.
